sections.title: Welcome to the Lobby
sections.intent: Introduce the protagonist's death and the absurdity of the System's arrival lounge.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist reaches the tutorial kiosk and receives his initial stat allocation.

sections.title: The Glitch in the Machine
sections.intent: Establish the 'Luck' stat exploit through experimentation on tutorial dummies.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.

sections.title: Tutorial Boss Logic
sections.intent: Demonstrate the build's viability in a low-stakes boss encounter.
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss is defeated via the 'Miss-Crit' exploit, granting passage to the world.

sections.title: Post-Game Analysis
sections.intent: Analyze the tutorial loot and identify the need for specialized movement gear.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist identifies the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' in a local shop's inventory.

sections.title: The Scavenger's Grind
sections.intent: Acquire enough currency through minor exploits to afford the gear.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist purchases the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' from a sketchy vendor.

sections.title: Calibration Run
sections.intent: Test the new movement speed in conjunction with the luck exploit.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully kites a pack of field mobs without taking a hit.

sections.title: Wildwood Infiltration
sections.intent: Navigate the initial layers of the Wildwood Dungeon solo.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist reaches the entrance to the Wildwood boss arena.

sections.title: The Kiting Masterclass
sections.intent: Engage the boss by using the environment and superior speed to avoid direct combat.
sections.end_condition: The boss is lured into a sequence of its own environmental traps.

sections.title: Flagged for Review
sections.intent: Complete the dungeon and trigger the System's automated exploit detection.
sections.end_condition: The boss dies and a System Notification warns of an 'Exploit Flag' on the protagonist's account.

sections.title: The Committee's Gavel
sections.intent: Show the immediate consequences of being flagged by the Balance Committee.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist is cornered by Balance Committee enforcers in a neutral zone.

sections.title: Breaking the Geometry
sections.intent: Escape the enforcers by exploiting a clipping glitch in the city walls.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully glitches through the environment to evade capture.

sections.title: Slumming It
sections.intent: Find temporary safety in the city's lawless district.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist reaches a safehouse in the slums, officially becoming a fugitive.

sections.title: The Unstoppable Object
sections.intent: Locate a potential ally who can survive the protagonist's chaotic playstyle.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist finds Barnaby, the disgraced tank, in a dive bar.

sections.title: The Sales Pitch
sections.intent: Convince Barnaby that an 'illegal' build is his only path back to relevance.
sections.end_condition: Barnaby agrees to a trial run and joins the protagonist's party.

sections.title: Field Test
sections.intent: Develop a tactical synergy between high-speed kiting and 'Unstoppable' tanking.
sections.end_condition: The duo clears a high-level patrol, confirming their synergy is viable.

sections.title: Breaching the Perimeter
sections.intent: Infiltrate the outer defenses of the Spire of Math.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist and Barnaby bypass the Spire's logic-gates and enter the main tower.

sections.title: The Vertical Climb
sections.intent: Fight through the tower's automated defense systems using physics exploits.
sections.end_condition: The party reaches the central processing core at the top of the Spire.

sections.title: Deleting the Evidence
sections.intent: Access the System terminal to remove the 'Exploit' flag before deletion occurs.
sections.end_condition: The 'Exploit' flag is successfully converted into a 'Unique Title' just as the deletion timer hits zero.

sections.title: The Guardian's Glitch
sections.intent: Defeat the Spire's final guardian using the newly acquired Unique Title.
sections.end_condition: The Spire Guardian is defeated, dropping the legendary 'Dev-Tool'.

sections.title: Structural Failure
sections.intent: Escape the collapsing Spire as the System attempts to rectify the logic error.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist and Barnaby exit the tower as it de-rezzes into raw data.

sections.title: Into the Frontier
sections.intent: Set out for the frontier zones where the System's rules are less rigid.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist crosses the border into the frontier, ready to break more rules.
